contractSummary: Final working-tree gate for a parent-facing local Mock UI refresh. Writes are restricted to the existing web app, shared UI styles, QA evidence, and TC Flow runtime. Backend, production auth, real upload, AWS, deployment, and GitHub push are non-goals.
task: Review the cumulative Feature against the frozen contract, seven passing task reviews, 10/10 Feature QA, memory, actual working-tree scope, and security boundaries. Pass only if the working tree matches scope and contains no P0 issue.
sanitizedDiff: The cumulative Feature contains local Stitch assets, a route-aware app shell, authentication/onboarding UI, growth/records/vaccine flows, moments gallery/detail, China-first parenting guide/detail with provenance, parent profile/edit/logout flows, independent root detail routes, 24 tests, responsive QA screenshots, and TC Flow evidence. Git status is limited to .tc-flow/, apps/web/apps/web/, apps/web/packages/ui/src/styles/globals.css, and docs/qa/stitch-parent-ui-refresh/, all of which are contract-allowed. Product images use local paths. The only product network URLs are visible article provenance links and a future provider registry; V1 performs no browser-side provider requests.
evidence: Seven task reviews passed without P0 findings.
Final tests passed 24/24; typecheck, production build, app-wide Biome, and git diff check passed.
Twelve parent routes had zero page-level overflow at 320px; six 390x844 screenshots were reviewed.
A clean ten-route browser session produced no console warning or error.
Actual working-tree changes are confined to the frozen allowed write paths.
No real family PII, credential, storage key, production authentication, backend persistence, file upload, AWS mutation, deployment, or medical diagnosis was introduced.
Feature and run memory were written without PII, secrets, full chat, or provider credentials.
